verb.title: The verb
verb.etymology: From the Greek Ōkeanós, “the river that encircles the earth”, and the Latin sanare, “to heal, to restore to health”, with the verb ending -ar.
senses: The act of being, and becoming, ocean.
To flow as a way of being.
To move to the rhythm of mystery; to inhabit the sea as identity and as action.

culture.title: Ocean culture
culture.body: A way of being in the world, an identity born from a deep bond with the sea. It is the set of values, practices and communities that recognize the ocean as a living being and as a teacher.
culture.conditionsLead: A person or a community lives ocean culture when they:

conditions.text: feel the ocean as a living being, not a backdrop;
let the sea teach them something about how to live;
act from that bond: caring, creating, connecting. TODO(contenido): connecting or sharing?

method.title: Doing as the sea does
method.lead: We don’t propose acting in the sea, or for the sea. We propose acting with the sea, as the sea.
